roles.title: Senior ML Engineer
roles.description: Join xAI to work on Grok, our flagship AI assistant. You will work on large language model training, inference optimization, and post-training techniques including RLHF. This role requires deep expertise in transformer architecture, distributed training systems, and experience with frontier model development. You will collaborate with world-class researchers to push the boundaries of AI capability.
roles.requirements: ["5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering","Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and CUDA","Experience with distributed training at scale","Deep understanding of transformer architecture and LLM training","Track record of published research or production ML systems","Experience with RLHF or other post-training techniques"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with JAX/TPU training","Contributions to open-source ML projects","PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field"]

roles.title: Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Build and maintain the infrastructure that powers Grok and xAI training systems. Work with Kubernetes, Terraform, and large-scale GPU clusters. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines, monitoring systems, and deployment automation for distributed training infrastructure.
roles.requirements: ["4+ years of infrastructure/SRE experience","Strong proficiency in Kubernetes and Terraform","Experience with Go or Rust for systems programming","Understanding of GPU computing and CUDA environments","Experience with distributed systems at scale"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with ML training infrastructure","Knowledge of networking for high-performance computing","Experience with cloud providers (GCP, AWS)"]

roles.title: Research Scientist, Multimodal
roles.description: Lead research on multimodal AI capabilities for Grok. Develop novel approaches to vision-language understanding, multimodal reasoning, and cross-modal transfer learning. Work on inference optimization and safety for multimodal systems. This role is at the frontier of AI research.
roles.requirements: ["PhD in Computer Science, AI, or related field","Published research in multimodal AI, computer vision, or NLP","Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch or JAX","Experience with large-scale model training","Deep understanding of transformer architecture"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with RLHF and post-training","Background in safety and alignment research","Experience with distributed training on GPU clusters"]

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.description: Build the backend systems that serve Grok to millions of users on X (Twitter) and other platforms. Design APIs, manage data pipelines, and optimize inference serving for real-time AI responses. Work with Python, Go, and distributed systems.
roles.requirements: ["3+ years of backend engineering experience","Strong proficiency in Python and Go","Experience with REST APIs and microservices","Understanding of database systems and caching strategies","Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with ML inference serving","Knowledge of LLM deployment patterns","Experience with Kubernetes and containerization"]

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.description: Protect xAI systems and data. Implement security controls for AI training infrastructure, conduct security reviews, and build automated security tooling. Work on AI safety and adversarial robustness.
roles.requirements: ["4+ years of security engineering experience","Experience with cloud security (GCP, AWS)","Strong understanding of network security and cryptography","Experience with security automation and tooling","Knowledge of compliance frameworks"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with AI/ML security","Background in adversarial machine learning","Rust or C++ proficiency"]

roles.title: Training Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Design and optimize large-scale distributed training infrastructure for frontier AI models. Work on GPU cluster management, training job scheduling, and performance optimization. This role is critical to xAI mission of building the most capable AI systems. Requires deep expertise in CUDA, distributed systems, and training infrastructure.
roles.requirements: ["5+ years of systems engineering experience","Expert knowledge of CUDA and GPU programming","Experience with distributed training frameworks (PyTorch, JAX)","Strong proficiency in C++ and Python","Experience with large-scale cluster management"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with custom training frameworks","Knowledge of network topology optimization for training","Contributions to distributed training open-source projects"]

roles.title: Post-Training Researcher
roles.description: Advance the state of the art in post-training techniques for Grok. Work on RLHF, DPO, and other alignment methods. Develop evaluation frameworks and safety benchmarks. This role directly impacts the quality and safety of Grok responses.
roles.requirements: ["PhD or equivalent research experience","Published work in RLHF, alignment, or post-training","Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch","Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale","Deep understanding of transformer architecture and inference optimization"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience with safety evaluation and red-teaming","Background in cognitive science or human feedback systems","Experience with multimodal post-training"]

roles.title: Technical Recruiter
roles.description: Source, recruit, and hire top AI talent for xAI. Partner with hiring managers across Research, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams. Build and maintain a pipeline of exceptional candidates from top AI labs and universities.
roles.requirements: ["3+ years of technical recruiting experience","Experience hiring ML/AI engineers and researchers","Strong sourcing skills and network in the AI community","Excellent communication and organizational skills"]
roles.nice_to_have: ["Experience recruiting at a top AI lab","Technical background or CS degree","Experience with high-volume, competitive hiring"]
